description: Cheapest Verdix check ($0.01): screen an EVM address on Base before sending it USDC or other funds, when the recipient is unknown or new to you. It checks OFAC sanctions, scam/phishing lists, address-poisoning lookalikes, burn addresses, phishing tokens and flagged contract deployers; it skips address age and the caution-only contract checks. Returns Verdix's JSON unchanged: verdict (no_known_risk | caution | danger), risk_score, reasons, checked, limited_checks (always true), checks_performed, not_checked, full_check, as_of. This tool NEVER returns "safe": the clean answer is "no_known_risk", which only means the address is on none of these lists - it is not a safety verdict. 'danger' means do not send funds. 'caution' means confirm with the user first. If you need a "safe" verdict (e.g. before a large or irreversible transfer), call check_address_risk_quick ($0.02) instead or after this one. PAID: calling this tool always costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402, paid from the wallet configured in this server (VERDIX_PRIVATE_KEY), and is refused up front if that is above VERDIX_MAX_PRICE_USD. A 503 answer (data unavailable) is not charged.
